scripts.text:
[Arena Point Manager]
I hope you're having a good
time in the Arena. If you've
earned Turbo Track Points at
Al De Baran's Turbo Track, I can,
convert them into Arena Points.
scripts.translation:
[竞技场点数管理员]
希望你在竞技场玩得开心。
如果你在艾尔帕兰的极速赛道获得了点数，我可以把它们转换成竞技场点数。

scripts.text: Point Check
scripts.translation: 查询点数

scripts.text: Convert Points
scripts.translation: 兑换点数

scripts.text: ^660000Conversion Info^000000

[Arena Point Manager]
{0},
you currently have
{1} Arena Points
and {2} Turbo Track Points.
scripts.translation:
[竞技场点数管理员]
{0}，你目前有{1}竞技场点数和{2}极速赛道点数。

scripts.text:
[Arena Point Manager]
Please choose from among
the Track Point to Arena Point
conversions. Keep in mind that
when you convert more than 10
Track Points at one time, you can only convert in ^4D4DFFmultiples of 10^000000.
scripts.translation:
[竞技场点数管理员]
请选择将极速赛道点数兑换成竞技场点数的方案。
请注意，一次兑换超过10赛道点数时，只能按^4D4DFF10的倍数^000000兑换。

scripts.text: 2 TP -> 1 AP
scripts.translation: 2 TP -> 1 AP

scripts.text: 4 TP -> 2 AP
scripts.translation: 4 TP -> 2 AP

scripts.text: 6 TP -> 3 AP
scripts.translation: 6 TP -> 3 AP

scripts.text: 8 TP -> 4 AP
scripts.translation: 8 TP -> 4 AP

scripts.text: 10 TP and more
scripts.translation: 10 TP 及以上

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Arena Point Manager]
Please enter the number
of times you wish to convert
10 Turbo Track Points into
Arena Points. The largest
value you may enter is 20.
To cancel, enter ''^3355FF0^000000.''
scripts.translation:
[竞技场点数管理员]
每次可将10极速赛道点数兑换成5竞技场点数，请输入兑换次数。
最多可输入20次。
若要取消，请输入“^3355FF0^000000”。

scripts.text:
[Arena Point Manager]
You have
canceled
this service.
scripts.translation:
[竞技场点数管理员]
你已取消此服务。

scripts.text:
[Arena Point Manager]
Your request exceeds
the maximum limit. Please
enter a value no greater than 20.
scripts.translation:
[竞技场点数管理员]
你输入的数值超过上限了。
请输入不大于20的数值。

scripts.text:
[Arena Point Manager]
You will exceed the
maximum amount of
Arena Points if we proceed
with this conversion of your
Turbo Track Points. You cannot
have more than 29,000 Arena Points.
scripts.translation:
[竞技场点数管理员]
兑换后，你的竞技场点数会超过上限。
竞技场点数不能超过29,000。

scripts.text:
[Arena Point Manager]
Please spend some of
your Arena Points before
using this service again.
Thank you for your patronage.
scripts.translation:
[竞技场点数管理员]
请先花掉一些竞技场点数，再使用这项服务。
感谢你的惠顾。

scripts.text:
[Arena Point Manager]
I'm sorry, but
you don't have enough
Turbo Track Points to
perform this Arena
Point conversion.
scripts.translation:
[竞技场点数管理员]
抱歉，你的极速赛道点数不足，无法兑换竞技场点数。
